name: Pikaia Turukana
original_name: ピカイア・トゥルカナ
source:
"At lunchtime, there was a corner where new students gathered.. I think the level will be higher this year."

[url=https://vndb.org/c43557]Rufen[/url]'s classmate. She's a tall and fair-skinned beautiful girl.

Contrary to her calm demeanor, she occasionally utters sharp words, but he does not have any malice in him. She comes from a good family.

She spends most of her time with her roommate, [url=https://vndb.org/c26062]Vena[/url]. She's a childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c43555]Mei[/url].
